structure: Confluence page 'Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields - V4', version 201, fetched to workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/6497338582.json (result.body is storage-format HTML on a single line, ~160 KB). Sections in order, with byte offsets into result.body: h2 'Live Animal Data Elements' (offset 750; intro notes on 'Applies at' and the three data levels Notification / Commodity line / Unit, then one large field table to 80408); h1 'Reason of Import' (80474, table to 100240); h1 'Animal Identifiers' (100306, table to 117195); h1 'Documents' (117232, table to 130668); h2 'Germinal Data Elements' (130705: intro paragraph 'applies to germinal products only - semen, embryos and ova ... at least one germinal identifier per animal', then one field table 131054-142625 with 7 rows and no header row of its own, its columns matching the page's other field tables: Field name, Attributes, Validation, Applies at (with 'Applicable to' commodity-code lists), Source, Mandatory, Example, Impacts; then a note 'Not required for germinal products: County Parish Holding (CPH) and Permanent Address'); h1 anchor 'address_block' / 'Address Block' (142865, inside the germinal section, a Standard Address Block table 143528-154371 with a header row Field Name | Attributes | Validation | Example | Impacts and 10 rows, each tagged ANIMALS and GERMINALS); h2 'Out of Scope Data Elements' (154437, table 154525-159780, columns Field Name | Notes | Date, 6 rows plus an empty row, of which 2 name germinals: 'Approved Establishment - germinals' and 'Package type - germinals', both 'de-scoped by' with no name or date given). The scope takes in only the Germinal Data Elements section through the Address Block table, plus the 2 germinal rows of the Out of Scope table: about 29 KB of the body, 17 field rows and 2 out-of-scope rows. Left out: the Live Animal Data Elements, Reason of Import, Animal Identifiers and Documents sections and the 4 non-germinal out-of-scope rows (Arrival time at port, Journey Log, Transport after BCP, Animal Identifier - Wing Ring). The page shows no status macro or decision log. A tag-stripped text copy of the body from the Germinal Data Elements heading to the end is at distil/extract/confluence-6497338582.work/germinal-to-end.txt (rows end in @@ROW@@, cells separated by |).

parts.title: Germinal Data Elements, Address Block and germinal out-of-scope rows
parts.scope: The whole scoped slice, small enough for one agent: the Germinal Data Elements section from its heading (body offset 130705) up to the Out of Scope Data Elements heading (154437), including the Address Block sub-section, plus only the two germinal rows of the Out of Scope Data Elements table. Stops before nothing else in scope; the live-animal sections are out of scope and read only for the column meanings and level definitions.
read: workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/6497338582.json, result.body: section h2 'Germinal Data Elements' with its intro paragraph, its field table and the note after it
Sub-section h1 'Address Block' (anchor address_block) with its intro paragraph and its table

For context only, not to claim: the note at the top of h2 'Live Animal Data Elements' defining 'Applies at' and Level 1 Notification / Level 2 Commodity line / Level 3 Unit, and that section's table header row for the column names
covers: The Germinal Data Elements intro: germinal products are semen, embryos and ova only, and a notification must be submitted with at least one germinal identifier per animal

The 7 rows of the germinal field table, each with its attributes/format, validation, applies-at level, 'Applicable to' commodity-code list, source, mandatory status, example and impacts tag: Total gross weight (kg) (numeric, max 1,000, min > 0, 2 decimal places, Notification level, Optional); Quantity (unit/pieces) (numeric max 1,000, Commodity Level, Mandatory to proceed); Temperature (enum Ambient/Chilled/Frozen, Commodity Level, Optional); Donor name/ID (string max 58, Unit Level, Optional); Collection date (date DD/MM/YYYY, Unit Level, Optional); Production date (date DD/MM/YYYY, Unit Level, Optional); Identification Number/Mark (string max 58, Unit Level, Optional)

The 12 commodity codes and names in each 'Applicable to' list (5111000 Semen - Cattle; 5119985 Embryos/Ova - Cattle, Goat, Horse, Pig, Sheep; 5119985 Semen - Dog or Cat, Goat, Horse, Pig, Rodent/Rabbit, Sheep), including that 5119985 is shared across many species
The note that County Parish Holding (CPH) and Permanent Address are not required for germinal products and apply to the animal journey only

The Address Block intro (use where a field is described as Standard Address Block; the parent field decides whether an address is required; validation applies once provided) and its 10 rows with attributes, validation, example and impacts: Name or Organisation name, **Transporter authorisation number, Address Line 1, Address Line 2, Town or city, County, Postal or Zip code, Country (country list from MDM), Telephone number, Email address
The 2 germinal out-of-scope rows, Approved Establishment - germinals and Package type - germinals, each 'de-scoped by' with no name or date: a gap claim for the missing who/when
Every blank or unstated value in these rows (empty validation cells, the missing header row of the germinal table, the unexplained ** on Transporter authorisation number) as a gap claim
